main_text.p:
Militiæ, sancta cum maiestate malorum
Tot læti gladios & tot crudelia passi.

HÆC vobis mage marmoribus vel mole superba Pyramidum, longos perduratura per annos Sancta piis incisa notis monimenta parauit Hieropolis; vobis etiam Crispinus amico Iusta facit voto & latio bonus ore parentat. Quod si ego nil aliud potero, vos carmine saltem Prosequar, & Siticen memorabo funera plausu Vestra pio, & vestras comitabor carmine flammas.
Ergo, Liber, populos procul ex Oriente remotos, Qua patet orbe olim Romana potentia victo, Ad Tanain ad Cimmerios atque vltima Ponti, Aureus a lura peragra viridique Lemanno.
Sauromatas, i, vise, doce, gelidósque Polonos, Quos modo cælesti renouatos Spiritus aura Progenuit miserans, longáque a nocte reduxit.

Orchadas, & Scotiæ plenis pete littora velis: Hic nuper lux illa Dei, verbúmque Salutis Sacrum illud nostræ manifesto lumine coram Explicuit sese, hic sedes tutíque receptus Sanctis Europæ exulibus profugísque parantur.

Vise anni Solísque vias, vbi nostra Canopum Gens videt, & nostris contraria sydera cernit Admirans, longè Europa Calpéque relictis A tergo, Ammericam propter, quà languidus annū Exiguum vertens, gelido sub sydere nobis Sol hyemem facit & currit breuioribus horis: Quà patet inque sinum pandit se diuite luco Bresilia; infelix supra execratáque tellus Cannibalum, Paranas infrà Lepetísque sonanti Murmure gemmarum & squammis crepitantibus auri In mare præcipites, iunêto simul agmine currunt.
I, Liber, & reduces iterum solare Britannos,

page.notes: The text is set in italic type throughout, which has been rendered as plain text where the italics could not be reliably distinguished. Several words are doubtful because of print quality and are not marked: "Sancta" (the final letter may be a damaged a), "Lemanno", "Calpéque", "Sydera" and "lura" may be misprints or damaged letters. The short catchword-like mark below the last line is a printer's signature/reference mark and was recorded in the signature element. The page has no page number. Speck and stain marks in the right margin are not printed text and have been omitted. The sentence continues beyond the scanned page's last line.
